HR Manager Job at Fort Hermon Limited




        
    

        
        Fort Hermon Limited - We are a dynamic engineering and construction company specializing in delivering high-quality infrastructure, building, and industrial projects. With a focus on innovation, safety, and technical excellence, we provide end-to-end solutions that meet global standards and exceed client expectations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Manager 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilties
     

            
    




	Talent Acquisition: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, specifically sourcing and hiring specialized roles such as Loan Officers, Credit Analysts, Branch Managers, and Operations staff.
	Policy Implementation: Develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks in alignment with labor laws and Central Bank guidelines.
	Performance Management: Drive the performance appraisal process, design KPI frameworks, and work with branch managers to address performance gaps.
	Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all HR activities comply with local labor laws, occupational health and safety regulations, and banking regulatory standards.
	Training & Development: Identify training needs across branches and design development programs to improve staff productivity, customer service, and credit assessment skills.
	Employee Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact for employee grievances, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution, fostering a positive and highly motivated work culture.
	Compensation & Benefits: Oversee payroll administration, benefits packages, and incentive schemes (including performance-based bonuses for recovery and sales teams).


Requirements and Qualifications


	Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or any related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 5 to 10 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years in a supervisory or managerial role specifically within a bank or microfinance institution (MFI).
	Professional Certification: Active membership or professional certification (e.g., CIPM, SHRM, PHRi, or equivalent) is highly preferred.
	Industry Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of Nigerian labor laws, HR best practices, and regulatory frameworks governing financial institutions.
	Skills: Strong leadership, conflict resolution, interpersonal communication, and organizational skills.
	Tech-Savviness: Proficiency with HR Information Systems (HRIS), applicant tracking systems, and payroll software.


Salary
N500,000 - N600,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Intterested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "HR Managerr" as the subject of the mail.

Note: If you have banking or financial experience as HR proffesional we would like to hear from you.
